description: Answers "magnetic storms next week / this month", "any storms expected on a given date?". NOAA's 27-day outlook: for each day the largest expected Kp and its storm level, the expected Ap index and 10.7 cm radio flux. Days are UTC calendar dates, as NOAA issues them. Reissued weekly; a coarse outlook, not a day-by-day forecast. Geophysical data only; no health information.
name: get_outlook_27day

days.description: From the current UTC day to the end of the outlook.

date.description: A UTC calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD, as NOAA dates the outlook; not shifted to any time zone.

kp.description: The largest Kp expected that day.

kpText.description: Kp as the apps write it: one decimal.

level.description: NOAA G-scale level. Kp is graded by the whole number it rounds to, so 4.67 is already G1.

issuedAt.description: When NOAA issued the outlook, UTC. It is reissued weekly.

sources.description: Where the data comes from and on what terms.

title: 27-day geomagnetic outlook
